text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Tomakomai♪
White lands, paper dancing in the air♪ Ah, Tomakomai♪
Even migratory birds take a little rest...♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That was "Come on Over to Tomakomai,"
written and composed by Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's keep it rollin' with another song♪
Please listen to—"Haskap-Colored Dreams"—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for listening!
I'd be super happy if you'd check out my Umastagram and Umatter too~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"And for anyone who wants to learn
more about Tomakomai—"
choice_data_list: We're handing out pamphlets over here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
These pamphlets are handmade by yours truly!
Please, take one and have a look-see♪

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hokko Tarumae-san?
That was such a lovely song today, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You always listen to me?
Thank you so much! That makes me wicked happy♪

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Say... did something really wonderful happen to you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Something good...?

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text: "Until recently... even if you smiled while singing, you'd occasionally let a look of fatigue slip through, wouldn't you? I was secretly worried about you."

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
“Still, lately you've been... bursting with energy!
I feel like you're shining brighter with every passing day.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much!
I'll work even harder, I swear...!

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for always brightening my day.
Make sure to cherish the "good things," okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...A 'good thing' that happened lately, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmm... No, it's not so much that something happened, but rather...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I felt like my stamina improved
thanks to our training.
Maybe that's why I was able to sing with so much energy!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: In other words, by "something good," you mean... Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just kidding!
Um, but seriously, thank you as always!
